stdout:
name: Console checks
on:
  push:
    paths: ['console/**', 'website/src/styles.css', 'website/public/assets/flick-128.webp', 'website/public/assets/favicon-32.png', 'hosted/lib/mixer_hosted/authorization/scope.ex', 'hosted/.tool-versions', '.github/workflows/console.yml']
  pull_request:
    paths: ['console/**', 'website/src/styles.css', 'website/public/assets/flick-128.webp', 'website/public/assets/favicon-32.png', 'hosted/lib/mixer_hosted/authorization/scope.ex', 'hosted/.tool-versions', '.github/workflows/console.yml']
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  console:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: console
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22.23.3'
      - uses: erlef/setup-beam@54075bcc5e249e4758d363f27d099f55d843f124
        with:
          version-file: hosted/.tool-versions
          version-type: strict
      - name: Record exact revision and runtime
        run: |
          git rev-parse HEAD
          node --version
          npm --version
          elixir --version
      - name: Release-check model and Solid view
        run: |
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          npm run typecheck
          npm test
          npm run build
